items.title: Staffing Rota Policy - Absence and Sick Leave (v4)
items.text:
Staffing Rota Policy: Absence and Sick Leave
Applies to all rostered care staff.

1. Reporting absence
All staff must log any absence in the staffing portal before the start of the affected shift, or as soon as practicable if sickness starts during a shift.

2. Fit notes
Absences of more than two consecutive days require a fit note from the GP, uploaded to the staffing portal within three working days of the first day of absence. Absences of two consecutive days or fewer do not require a fit note, but staff may be asked for one if the manager has concerns.

3. Unpaid absence
Absence without a fit note where one is required may be treated as unauthorised and unpaid.

4. Return to work
Staff returning from sickness must confirm availability through the portal at least 24 hours before their first rostered shift back.

Review date: 1 November 2026. Questions to the rostering coordinator.
